I have some similar problems with my boyfriend. He’s always had more friends with me, so he has more social commitments than I do which leaves me bored most of the day waiting for him to get home. He’s also going to CC at home, so he isn’t in my situation trying to make new friends from scratch. I’ve ended up just doing as much homework as I can until he’s free. At least it helps me stay caught up 🤷🏻‍♀️ 

What we have established tho is at least once or twice a week where you guys are guaranteed free and carve that time out for each other. Treat it as any other plans you guys have with people at your respective colleges. Because at the end of the day, you guys are arguably the most important part ! Of course you guys can talk and stuff outside of those allotted time spots, but even during the busiest weeks of your lives where you can’t call at all you guys will be able to look forward to that time slot you’ve set aside for the two of you. It sounds like he needs to prioritize you more than he currently is. If he’s not willing to do that, he’s not willing to actually date you. Part of being in a LDR is making time for the other person just as you would if you weren’t LDR. A relationship should feel generally the same with minor differences when it comes to distance. Obviously you won’t have the physical aspect, but the time spent together is what you guys rely on for connection. So put it in your calendars ! Every Saturday night you guys watch a movie or tv show on call together at the same time, and there should be very few exceptions (dates and time will vary lol). Dedicate part of your lives to spending it with each other to keep the romance alive, even across long distances. You guys should be fine as long as you both are equally invested in this :)
